scripts.clean:deps: rm -rf node_modules extension/node_modules worker/node_modules website/node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lockb extension/bun.lock worker/bun.lock 2>/dev/null || true && echo '🧹 清理完成'
scripts.build: bun run env:sync:dev && bun run --filter @yiveno/design-tokens typecheck && bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n extension,worker,web -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run --cwd extension build:compile" "bun run build:worker" "bun run --cwd website build:dev:compile"
scripts.build:prod: bun run env:sync:prod && bun run env:check:prod && bun run --filter @yiveno/design-tokens typecheck && bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n extension,worker,web -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run --cwd extension build:prod:compile" "bun run build:worker" "bun run --cwd website build:prod:compile"
scripts.watch:stream: bun run env:sync:dev && bunx concurrently --names extension,worker,web --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "bun run --cwd extension build:watch" "bun run dev:worker" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.doc:check:all: bun run doc:check && bun run doc:check:consistency && bun run docs:check-diagrams
scripts.lint: bun run format && bunx concurrently -n ext-es,wrk-es,web-es,ext-st,web-st -c cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta "bun run --cwd extension eslint" "bun run --cwd worker eslint" "bun run --cwd website eslint" "bun run --cwd extension stylelint" "bun run --cwd website stylelint"
scripts.lint:check: bunx concurrently -n ext-es,wrk-es,web-es,ext-st,web-st -c cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta "bun run --cwd extension eslint:check" "bun run --cwd worker eslint:check" "bun run --cwd website eslint:check" "bun run --cwd extension stylelint:check" "bun run --cwd website stylelint:check"
scripts.test:run: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n extension,worker -c cyan,green "bun run --cwd extension test:run" "bun run --cwd worker test"
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd extension clean && bun run --cwd worker clean
